title: The Gospel of Mary
author: Christopher Tuckett
description: Christopher Tuckett examines the Gospel of Mary, an early Christian text concerned with revelation, discipleship and spiritual authority. The work provides a route into Mary's role in the surviving dialogue and the interpretation of its fragmentary witness.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection.
